text:
kai: Heads-up — I found a broken symlink in the docs repo causing a 404 for the French onboarding screenshot on staging.

kai: Page is /docs/getting-started/local-setup/index.md and the image path is `/static/images/fr/onboarding-screenshot.png` but the file in repo is a symlink to `../assets/onboarding.png` that doesn't exist on the build machine.

kai: Quick repro: `ls -l docs/static/images/fr` shows `onboarding-screenshot.png -> ../assets/onboarding.png` (broken).

michelle: thanks for flagging. is this a recent regression or has it always been a symlink?

kai: looks recent — blame shows `git blame` points to @sam from last month when we reorganized assets.

sam: yep that was me. i used symlinks to dedupe but the static builder doesn't follow them in the staging build container. my bad.

sam: i can open a tiny PR to replace the symlink with a real copy under `static/images/fr/` and update the asset list. should be 2–3 lines + one image file.

michelle: SGTM. please add a short test in the docs CI job? otherwise we'll reintroduce this later. maybe a quick `test -f` check in the docs-build step for images referenced by markdown.

sam: good idea. i'll add: ```bash
# in docs/ci/check_assets.sh
for img in $(grep -oP "\(/static/images/[^")]+\)" -R docs | sed 's/\(//;s/\)//'); do
  test -f "$img" || { echo "MISSING: $img"; exit 2; }
done
```

sam: will include that script and a CHANGELOG line; pinging @docs-codeowners for review (added in PR body). :memo:

kai: thanks — can you also add a short note in the PR about why symlinks are avoided (builder limitation + container FS)? helps future contributors.

sam: yup. pushing branch now. PR link will follow.

docs-bot: CI queued for PR #1234 — docs/build-image-check (pending) :hourglass_flowing_sand:

michelle: perfect — tag me when CI passes, i'll do a quick approve and merge. thanks for the fast pickup. :rocket:

sam: done, PR #1234 opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234 — includes image, check script, and a short note.

kai: confirmed staging renders the FR page correctly after the PR. thanks team! :tada:
